source: 1968 Chevrolet Chassis Service Manual, Heater and Air Conditioning, p.1A-30

procedures.title: Evaporator control valve (POA): check
steps: Check suction pressure at the POA valve under performance-test conditions; this is the only operating check for the valve.
If the reading is wrong for the altitude, replace the valve; it cannot be repaired or adjusted.

specs.what: POA gauge reading at sea level

notes: Applies to Four-Season systems on all vehicles.
The POA is an absolute-pressure valve, so the gauge reading depends on altitude: 29.5 psig at sea level, rising one-half psi per additional 1000 feet.
